name: Animated Header
summary: Scroll-aware animated header component for Next.js, built with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Motion, inspired by Vercel's header.
description: A single animated header component for Next.js that reacts to scroll, styled with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui and animated with Motion. The project is a demo app around the component and also integrates the author's Animated Tabs component; clone the repository, install dependencies and run the dev server, or open the live demo deployed on Vercel.
contains: scroll-aware animated header component for Next.js
built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Motion
includes the Animated Tabs component for navigation
clone-and-run demo with a live Vercel deployment
